$comment: The retained-mode UI library behind bblite/pal_ui.hpp. vcpkg carries an rmlui port, but not at this pinned revision and not carrying the native/patches/rmlui-*.patch files listed under `patches` (docs/ui.md states what each corrects), so the library is built from this commit by tools/build-rmlui.ps1 into artifacts/tools/rmlui -- the same shape the pinned Dawn, Tint and LabSound builds take. The script applies every listed patch (the list must equal the directory; the artifact records the commit and each patch's SHA-256, and native/CMakeLists.txt refuses an artifact whose record differs), enables RmlUi's inline-SVG plugin for development, and installs Backends/RmlUi_Platform_SDL.{h,cpp}, which RmlUi builds only under its samples and never installs; FreeType and LunaSVG stay vcpkg concerns supplied by the ui manifest feature for both the artifact build and each consuming tree.
